ext.status: In the making at the atelier
ext.title: More length. *More volume.* More you.
ext.lead: Andrea is currently making her extensions from Brazilian human hair, in six methods. Ask now: she will get back to you personally with colour, length and price.

methods.name: Clip-in
methods.text: Clip them in yourself. Your hair is shoulder-length and you would like more length? Put the piece in, done. No salon appointment.

methods.name: Tape-in
methods.text: Fine wefts with adhesive strips that hold your own hair flat between them.

methods.name: Invisible Tape
methods.text: Especially narrow, thin tapes that barely add bulk at the root.

methods.name: Keratin bonds
methods.text: Individual strands attached with keratin, for volume exactly where it is missing.

methods.name: Butterfly Weft
methods.text: A light weft that lies flat, for lots of volume with only a few rows.

methods.name: Genius Weft
methods.text: An ultra-thin weft that can be cut to size and lies flat against the head.

ext.forAllTitle: For every hair colour. For every texture.
ext.forAll: Blonde, copper, red, brunette, black, grey. Straight, wavy, curly, coily. Andrea matches colour and texture with you, by photo or at the atelier.
ext.ctaNote: No obligation. No price without a personal reply.
ext.salon: Would you like to use extensions in your salon or resell them? Ask the atelier directly about quantities.
ext.imageAlt: Human hair wefts in blonde, brown and gold tones side by side on dark stone: weft, tape, bonds and clip-in

real.title: Can people *tell?*
real.lead: Come closer. The parting, texture, colour and hold decide whether a hairpiece stands out.

shots.label: The parting
shots.text: Every single hair is injected by hand into an ultra-thin nano-skin base. The parting falls wherever you want it.

shots.label: The texture
shots.text: Straight, softly waved or curly: just the way your own hair falls.

shots.label: The colour
shots.text: Salt and pepper, copper, black or ash blonde. Every piece has its own natural colour.

shots.label: The hold
shots.text: Small clips hold the topper in your own hair. On in seconds, off just as quickly in the evening.

items.title: Putting it on
items.text: Open the clips, place the topper, close the clips. A few seconds, no glue, no appointment.

items.title: Wearing it
items.text: The nano-skin base is ultra-thin and lies flat. Your own hair at the sides stays; the piece complements it.

items.title: Caring for it
items.text: Adhesives, tapes and solvents for hair systems are available at the atelier, the same ones Andrea uses herself. She answers care questions personally.

hand.title: Andrea knows *how it feels.*
hand.lead: Andrea has worked with hair since she was 19, starting in Rio de Janeiro. She knows hair loss from her own experience and wears a hairpiece she made herself. That is why her atelier has one rule: it must be real, and it must hold up in everyday life.
hand.quote: “I know exactly what hair means to a person, because I have lived it myself.”
hand.hours: Mon to Fri 10 am to 7 pm · Sat 10 am to 2 pm
hand.imageAlt: Phoenix wings made of golden strands of hair against a dark background

Not when you order. Andrea checks your piece and confirms your order personally. Only then will you receive the payment details.

about.metaDescription: Andrea has worked with hair since she was 19, starting in Rio de Janeiro. Today she makes extensions, toppers, wigs and hair systems from Brazilian human hair in her atelier in Iserlohn.
about.title: It is not just hair. *It is so much more.*
about.lead: The story of Andreia Pereira Da Costa, whom everyone calls Andrea: from Rio de Janeiro to an atelier in Iserlohn.

chapters.label: Rio de Janeiro
chapters.title: It begins *at 19.*
chapters.text: In Rio de Janeiro, Andrea starts working with hair and stays with it for many years. In Brazil, hair matters a great deal. People care about it because it is more than beauty.
chapters.quote: “Your hair shows who you are inside, from the inside out.”

chapters.label: A new start
chapters.title: A new country. *A new language.*
chapters.text: Andrea moves to Germany. Because she speaks hardly any German at first, she spends many years working in care, with people with disabilities. There she learns to meet people with patience and dignity. It still shapes the way she advises today.

chapters.label: Her own experience
chapters.title: She knows *how it feels.*
chapters.text: Andrea knows hair loss from her own experience. She wears a hairpiece that she made herself. Whoever comes to her talks to someone who knows that look in the mirror.
chapters.quote: “I know exactly what hair means to a person, because I have lived it myself.”

chapters.label: It has to be real
chapters.title: Real. *And made for everyday life.*
chapters.text: She once tried a hairpiece made from other hair. It let her down in everyday life, in the sauna for example. Since then one thing is clear to her: it has to be real hair, and it has to prove itself in life, not just in the mirror.

chapters.label: The atelier
chapters.title: Back *to hair.*
chapters.text: About three years ago, Andrea founded her own atelier in Iserlohn and returned to her craft: extensions, toppers, wigs and hair systems from Brazilian human hair, also made to measure.
chapters.quote: “I am happiest in my atelier, when I am making my pieces.”

chapters.label: The phoenix
chapters.title: As if *reborn.*
chapters.text: Her sign is the phoenix. It stands for before and after. Anyone who has lost hair, through alopecia or simply over the years, and gets it back, feels as if reborn.
chapters.quote: “When your hair is back, you are a different person. You are as if reborn.”

chapters.label: What drives her
chapters.title: Why *she does it.*
chapters.text: Andrea wants to help people who feel the way she once felt. For every hair colour, every texture, every background. No one should think: this is not for me.
chapters.quote: “What matters to me is that I help people. Then my conscience is at peace.”
